bias.en: Breakdown · lost $179–181 on heavy volume, oversold
bias.zh: 破位 · 放量跌破 $179–181，超卖

read.en: Nvidia fell 4.3% on Nov 9 to $178.67, trading $170.24–179.92 on volume 3.9 times its 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($190.75), 10-day ($200.74), 30-day ($216.85) and 100-day ($213.73) averages and the rising 200-day ($204.63). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($202.23), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月9日下跌 4.3%，收于 $178.67，盘中区间 $170.24–179.92，成交量为 20 日均量的 3.9 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$190.75）、10 日（$200.74）、30 日（$216.85）和 100 日均线（$213.73）以及上行的 200 日均线（$204.63）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$202.23），RSI 为 27，处于超卖。

read.en: The close broke the $181.5 Nov 5 low and the $179.2–179.9 February–March lows, now resistance; the close held above $176.8–177.6. Resistance is $179.2–181.5, then $186.6 (Nov 6 close) and $189.8–190.8 (June–July lows, 5-day). Support is $176.8–177.6 (Jan 20 and Oct 2025 lows), then $170.2 (Nov 9 low) and $164.3 (52-week low). A close above $181.5 would target $186.6–190.8; below $176.8, $170.

r.en: Feb 17 low $179.18; Mar 13 low $179.94; Nov 5 low $181.46, all lost
